summary: Exposed knife on the island and runner rug edges present cut and trip risks.

hazards.title: Unsecured Kitchen Knife
hazards.detail: Large chef knife left loose on the island countertop edge risking cuts.
fixSteps: Store knife in a wooden knife block or magnetic rack.
Keep sharp blades away from counter edges.

hazards.title: Unsecured Kitchen Runner Rug
hazards.detail: Runner rug lacks grip tape and edges could curl, causing a trip hazard.
fixSteps: Apply non-skid rug tape along all edges.
Ensure runner lies completely flat against floor.

hazards.title: Towel Hanging on Oven Handle
hazards.detail: Cloth towel hanging directly on the oven door handle poses a heat risk.
fixSteps: Relocate fabric towels away from oven and cooktop.
Use a wall hook away from heating elements.

hazards.title: Appliance Cord Near Sink
hazards.detail: Countertop appliance sits close to sink basin creating splash risk.
fixSteps: Move air fryer further away from the sink area.
Keep electrical cords tidy and dry.

products.name: Universal Knife Block
products.reason: Safely stores exposed knives off countertop surfaces.

products.name: Non-Slip Rug Grippers
products.reason: Anchors runner rug edges to prevent tripping.
